title: ModelDelta
description: Plugin -> engine. One committed Revit transaction = one delta, applied atomically to the cloud twin. Lightweight geometry only (bounding boxes, optional transform); the heavy model never leaves the client. Metres, project shared coordinates (the plugin converts from Revit internal feet and applies ActiveProjectLocation.GetTotalTransform()).

modelId.description: The RVT (or linked model) this delta comes from; part of every element id.

sequence.description: Client-monotonic per model; the server log offset orders across clients. Never wall-clock time.

transactionId.description: Idempotency key: a redelivered delta with the same id is a no-op.

event.description: document_changed = unsynced local edit (live preview); synchronized_with_central = committed.

versionGuid.description: Element.VersionGuid at the time of the change (equality only, never ordered).

transform.description: Optional 3x4 row-major rigid transform for non-axis-aligned solids.

system.description: MEP system name, for MEP elements only.
